content.json:
# UniFi Syslog
Events forwarded by **UniFi Syslog Server** to `UnifiSyslog_CL` and, in split table mode, firewall and IPS events in `CommonSecurityLog` (DeviceVendor Ubiquiti, DeviceProduct UniFi). Both tables are combined in every query.

parameters.name: Site
parameters.label: Site
parameters.query:
union isfuzzy=true (UnifiSyslog_CL | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange} | project Site),
    (CommonSecurityLog | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange} | where DeviceVendor == "Ubiquiti" and DeviceProduct == "UniFi" | project Site = DeviceCustomString1)
| where isnotempty(Site)
| summarize by Site
| order by Site asc

content.query:
let UniFi = union isfuzzy=true
    (UnifiSyslog_CL
    | project TimeGenerated, Site, Hostname, DeviceName, Category, EventType, Action, Rule, Severity, SrcIp, SrcPort, DstIp, DstPort, Protocol, SrcCountry, DstCountry, ClientMac, ClientName, Ssid, Message),
    (CommonSecurityLog
    | where DeviceVendor == "Ubiquiti" and DeviceProduct == "UniFi"
    | project TimeGenerated, Site = DeviceCustomString1, Hostname = Computer, DeviceName, Category = DeviceEventCategory,
        EventType = coalesce(extract(@"(?:^|;)event_type=([^;]*)", 1, AdditionalExtensions), "packet"), Action = DeviceAction, Rule = DeviceEventClassID,
        Severity = case(LogSeverity == "10", 1, LogSeverity == "9", 2, LogSeverity == "7", 3, LogSeverity == "5", 4, LogSeverity == "3", 5, LogSeverity == "1", 6, 7),
        SrcIp = SourceIP, SrcPort = SourcePort, DstIp = DestinationIP, DstPort = DestinationPort, Protocol = tolower(Protocol),
        SrcCountry = extract(@"(?:^|;)src_country=([^;]*)", 1, AdditionalExtensions), DstCountry = extract(@"(?:^|;)dst_country=([^;]*)", 1, AdditionalExtensions),
        ClientMac = SourceMACAddress, ClientName = "", Ssid = "", Message)
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where '*' in ({Site}) or Site in ({Site});
UniFi
| summarize Events = count(), ['Firewall blocks'] = countif(Category == "firewall" and Action == "block"), ['IPS alerts'] = countif(Category == "ips"),
    ['Sign-in failures'] = countif(Action == "fail" and Category in ("auth", "admin", "vpn", "access")), Devices = dcount(Hostname), Sites = dcount(Site)
| evaluate narrow()
| project Metric = Column, Count = tolong(Value)
